summary: Build a complete local ERP system for 'Speed Motors' (motorcycle parts) with inventory/stock management, multi-currency cash register, sales/credits tracking, full CRUD, backup export, and deliver the project as a downloadable ZIP.
architectural_notes: Target deployment: run as a local server on the user's PC without external platforms.
Preferred stack requested by user: Python Flask backend + SQLite single-file database; HTML templates + static CSS/JS.
known_issues: Platform/tooling limitation noted: assistant claims it cannot generate Flask/SQLite projects or ZIPs unless using Motoko + React (potential delivery mismatch with requested stack).

existing_features.title: Add a user-visible download UI in the Speed Motors ERP that lets the user download the generated ZIP files (app-build.zip and source-code.zip) and the SOURCE_CODE.md file, with clear statuses when files are not yet available.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create full ERP for Speed Motors (motorcycle parts) using Python Flask backend and SQLite database, runnable locally.
Inventory/stock module: optional photo/description, current stock, minimum stock with red alerts, purchase price USD, auto sale price from configurable margin.
Multi-currency cash register: automatic conversion to VES (BCV) and COP using an exchange-rate table editable daily.
Sales and credits: invoices with multiple products; 'Pay Now' posts to cash; 'On Credit' adds to debtors with 15-day overdue alert; apply similarly for suppliers.
Full CRUD: all records must have Edit and Delete actions.
Backup/export button to export the entire database to Excel/CSV.
Deliver complete project file structure (app.py, templates/, static/ with CSS/JS).
Package and provide a downloadable ZIP of the built ERP project via chat/tooling.
Ensure the project produces ZIP artifacts for the Speed Motors ERP and stages them as static files served by the frontend at /artifacts/ so the user can download them from the running app.
Complete the included DEPLOY_README.md so that the ZIP build artifact has usable, English deployment instructions for extracting and deploying the packaged build.
